hints.title: Initial Two Numbers Completely Determine the Sequence
hints.text: Once the lengths and values of the first two numbers are established, every following number in the sequence is strictly forced to be their sum.

hints.title: Leading Zero Handling and Boundary Conditions
hints.text: Numbers with multiple digits cannot begin with digit zero. Enforce that numbers greater than single zero never have a leading zero.

hints.title: Iterating Splits and Checking Prefix Sums
hints.text: Pick index i for the first number and j for the second. Parse n1 and n2. While remaining digits exist, form sum c, check if string continues with c, and update pointers until end of string is reached.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of digits string num
complexity.notes: Optimal deterministic search testing O(N^2) initial split points with linear O(N) forward string verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary recursive backtracking explores redundant branchings that violate strict additive consistency.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating forward validation with integer summation avoids complex parsing data structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle leading zero constraints and use large integer arithmetic to avoid numeric overflow.
